items.title: For those of you building AI agents, how have you made them faster?
items.raw_excerpt: Because of the coordination across multiple systems + chaining LLM calls, a lot of agents today can feel really slow. I would love to know how others are tackling this: - How are you all identifying performance bottlenecks in agents? - What types of changes have gotten you the biggest speedups? For us we vibe-coded a profiler to identify slow LLM calls - sometimes we could then switch out a faster model for that step or we'd realize we could shrink the input tokens by eliminating unnecessary context. For steps requiring external access (browser usage, API calls), we've moved to fast start external containers + thread pools for parallelization. We've also experimented some with UI changes to mask some of the latency. What other performance enhancing techniques are people using?

items.title: 「举家」托举千问，阿里在赌什么？
items.raw_excerpt: “一口气点 40 杯霸王茶姬的伯牙绝弦。” “接入支付宝签证、户口、公积金等 50 余项政务服务。” “变成每位老师的 AI 助教。” 1 月 15 日，在千问产品发布会上，千问正式宣布全面接入淘宝、支付宝、淘宝闪购、飞猪、高德等阿里生态业务，一口气上线点外卖、买东西、订机票等 400 多项新功能，AI 从聊天迈入办事时代。 如果只把这次千问更新理解为“又多接了几个阿里系的 App”，可能低估了它的意义。阿里千问 C 端事业群总裁吴嘉在开场中表示：“千问是第一个真正能帮你办事的 AI。” 这次更新的功能横跨生活、工作和教育，在现场分别由三个产品经理一一讲解。看似分散，但背后指向同一个变化——千问正在由“聊天助手”转向“办事助理”。用吴嘉的话说，AI 要从副驾驶走向主驾驶。 更为重要的是，在接入的外卖、电商等场景中，千问第一次触碰了“交易”。在阿里体系内，任何产品一旦触碰到交易，就意味这不再是实验产品，而是进入了真正的业务验证期。 千问的这次更新，或将成为模型应用商业化落地的新范式。 量到位之后，阿里才开始”谈入口” 回看过去一年，C 端 AI 应用的主流形态，几乎都停留在“对话框里解决问题”。千问的变化，是从“给建议”走向“给结果”。 当用户提出消费需求后，千问会直接调用阿里体系内的能力：地址信息来自淘宝闪购，商品与商家推荐来自本地供给，支付与履约来自支付宝，整个流程完整留在阿里生态内。 在雷峰网 1 月 9 日的实测中，千问已经可以在平台内完成从接收需求到选购再到付款的全流程。比如点一杯咖啡，平台会优先推荐附近商家，并支持向左滑动筛选品类，还有“千问爆红包”给予补贴。以雷峰网所在区域为例，一杯星巴克的抹茶可可星冰乐，最终实付 18.5 元。 放在行业层面，千问正在从 AI 助手变成 AI 交易入口，这也是国内模型应用第一次真正承担这一角色。 在海外，这条路径已经被落实和验

excerpt_i18n.en:
Ordering 40 cups of Bawang Tea's 'Bo Ya Jue Xian' in one go. Accessing over 50 government services on Alipay, including visas, household registration, and provident funds. Becoming an AI teaching assistant for every teacher. On January 15, at the Qwen product launch event, Qwen officially announced its full integration into Alibaba's ecosystem, including Taobao, Alipay, Taobao Flash Sales, Fliggy, and Amap, rolling out over 400 new features at once, such as ordering takeout, shopping, and booking flights. AI is transitioning from chatting to getting things done. 

If this Qwen update is merely seen as "adding a few more Alibaba apps," its significance might be underestimated. Wu Jia, President of Alibaba's Qwen C-end Business Group, stated in the opening remarks, "Qwen is the first AI that can truly help you accomplish tasks." The new features span daily life, work, and education, each explained by three product managers on stage. While seemingly scattered, they point to the same shift—Qwen is evolving from a "chat assistant" to a "task assistant." As Wu Jia put it, AI is moving from the passenger seat to the driver's seat.

More importantly, in scenarios like food delivery and e-commerce, Qwen is now touching "transactions" for the first time. Within Alibaba's ecosystem, once a product involves transactions, it is no longer an experimental offering but enters a genuine business validation phase.

This Qwen update may set a new paradigm for the commercial application of AI models. Only after achieving scale has Alibaba begun to "discuss entry points."

Looking back over the past year, the mainstream form of C-end AI applications has largely remained confined to "solving problems within a dialog box."
excerpt_i18n.es: "Pedir 40 tazas de té Bóyá Juexián de Bawang Chaji de una sola vez." "Integrar más de 50 servicios gubernamentales como visados, registro de hogar y fondos de vivienda en Alipay." "Convertirse en el asistente de IA de cada profesor." El 15 de enero, en la presentación del producto Qianwen, se anunció oficialmente su integración completa en los servicios del ecosistema de Alibaba, como Taobao, Alipay, Taobao Flash, Fliggy y Amap, lanzando de golpe más de 400 nuevas funciones, como pedir comida a domicilio, comprar productos y reservar billetes de avión, marcando la transición de la IA desde la conversación hacia la realización de tareas. Si esta actualización de Qianwen se interpreta simplemente como "conectar unas cuantas apps más del grupo Alibaba", se podría estar subestimando su importancia.
